title: Support pre-start prequel timeline expansion and connecting past-to-future branches

sections.what: Add pre-start timeline expansion (shifting calendar epoch earlier while preserving existing calendar dates via tick offset) and non-destructive past-to-future branch connection (propagating prequel memories/relationships/deaths onto a future branch).
sections.why: Authors currently cannot play or author a prequel before Tick 0 of an existing scenario or propagate prequel outcomes forward into an authored later branch.
sections.how: Add expand_timeline_earlier(world, delta_days, stream_store=None) and connect_branches(world, source_branch_id, target_branch_id, label='') in engine/timeline.py plus StreamStore.shift_ticks(world_id, delta_ticks) in engine/stream_store.py. Expose POST /api/timeline/expand-past and POST /api/timeline/connect in routes/timeline_ops.py.

acceptance.text: POST /api/timeline/expand-past shifts calendar_config start date earlier and offsets existing time_ticks, checkpoint ticks, memory ticks, and stream event ticks forward by delta_ticks so existing history stays pinned to its calendar date

POST /api/timeline/connect merges non-conflicting outcomes (memories, relationships, deaths) from an earlier prequel branch onto a target future branch checkpoint, creating a new connected branch without mutating either source branch

custom.browser_ui: Authors can expand a scenario earlier in time to play a May prequel before an October start, then connect prequel outcomes forward into the October branch without losing either branch.
